title: Chronology and Sequence of Premonitory Symptoms
official: Chronology and Sequence of Premonitory Symptoms to Understand How Migraine Attack Starts: the CHRONOpS Study
summary: The purpose of this study is to prospectively investigate the temporal sequence of premonitory symptoms across multiple migraine attacks.

sites.f: Sapienza University of Rome, Polo Pontino, centro cefalee, ICOT
